To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) substantial variation in length of hospital stay exists between and within hospitals, (2) there has been no decrease in variation in LOS over time, (3) there is no correlation between hospitals’ performance in LOS across different diagnoses and procedures and (4) within-hospital variation is many times greater than variation between hospitals.

(i) the variation in LOS has not decreased between and within hospitals for most diagnoses and procedures, (ii) the within-hospital variance is many times greater than the between-hospital variance, and (iii) the variation between hospitals is much smaller than the variation within hospitals.
